demos.title: Cool and Detect
demos.subtitle: Doppler cool, spin-polarise, look twice
demos.note: The simplest thing the trap does, and the backbone of every other sequence: 1 ms of 397 at -25 MHz, a 20 us sigma pulse, then two 200 us detection windows at -10 MHz.

demos.title: 729 Carrier Sweep
demos.subtitle: 41 points across the qubit transition
demos.note: A shaped 3.3 us probe walks across the carrier while everything else stays put. The pitch of the 729 voice is the scan.

demos.title: GKP QEC, one mode
demos.subtitle: Error-correction rounds, 1 to 81
demos.note: The QEC block is a LoopSequence whose iteration count is the scanned parameter, so the correction cycle repeats more and more times before readout. That is the lifetime measurement.

demos.title: GKP QEC, two modes
demos.subtitle: Super Gate, both radial modes
demos.note: Same idea on both radial modes at once (2.543 and 2.805 MHz). Sideband cooling alternates between them, and the SDF pulses carry a two-tone structure around the carrier.
